PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-honest-side-side|COREMERCH guide to payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators|Tron USDT]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

When it comes to selling ebooks in Nigeria, options like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle seem appealing, but they come with significant limitations, especially when it comes to payment processing, fees, and user experience. For instance, Gumroad's transaction fees can range from 3.5% to 8% per sale, while Lemon Squeezy charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, and Paddle's fees start at 5% + 30¢ per sale. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust, scalable solution that deploys in 48 hours, complete with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, providing a seamless user experience and significantly lower fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Another critical aspect of ecommerce infrastructure is how it handles restricted countries, where payment processors like Stripe, PayPal, and others are either unavailable or severely restricted. Gumroad, for example, allows creators to set up stores in restricted countries, but it can't guarantee payment processing, while Lemon Squeezy has a more limited reach, with fewer payment options available to creators in these markets. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that operates independently of payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are also critical considerations for ebook authors selling in Nigeria. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can enjoy faster payment processing, lower fees, and more control over their financial transactions. For example, NOWPayments, which is integrated into the Edge Commerce Stack, offers instant payment processing and a 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for creators looking to minimize their costs.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) operates independently of payment processors, providing faster payment processing, lower fees, and more control over your financial transactions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ebook delivery, creators want to ensure that their products are delivered seamlessly to their customers, while also maintaining ownership and control over their digital assets. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a robust automation framework that enables creators to deliver their ebooks instantly, while also giving them complete ownership and control over their digital assets. With Supabase, creators can store and manage their orders, and with Cloudflare Pages, they can host their digital products, all within a secure and scalable infrastructure.
